result.topic_en: Euler reduces the fifth through tenth members of a double-integral variation expression by repeated integration by parts, expressing each in terms of single integrals and a double integral involving derivatives of Q', Q'', R, R', R'', R'''.
result.transcription:
52 METHODVS NOVA CALCVLVM
Simili modo quintum membrum ope ſecundi reducitur vbi loco P ſcribitur $Q'$ et loco $\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,x\,d\,t}\right)$, $\left(\frac{d^3\,z}{d\,x\,d\,y\,d\,t}\right)$; ſiue loco $\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)$ ſcribendo $\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,y\,d\,t}\right)$ ſicque habebitur
$\iint Q'\left(\frac{d^3\,z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right)dx\,dy = \int Q'\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{dy\,dt}\right)dy - \iint\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,y\,d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,Q'}{d\,x}\right)dx\,dy$
quod poſterius membrum cum tertio conferatur, vbi loco tantum $P''$ ſcribi debet $\left(\frac{d\,Q'}{d\,x}\right)$, quo pacto totum membrum induet hanc formam:
$\int Q'\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,y\,d\,t}\right)dy - \int\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,Q'}{d\,x}\right)dx + \iint\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,d\,Q'}{d\,x\,d\,y}\right)dx\,dy$,
ſextum vero membrum bis cum ſecundo collatum reducitur ad hanc formam:
$\int Q''\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,y\,d\,t}\right)dx - \int\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,Q''}{d\,y}\right)dx + \iint\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,d\,Q''}{d\,y^2}\right)dx\,dy$
28. Si hoc modo vlterius progrediamur ad ſequentia membra, ſeptimum membrum in ſequentes partes reſoluitur:
$\int R\left(\frac{d^3\,z}{d\,x^2\,d\,t}\right)dy - \int\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,x\,d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,R}{d\,x}\right)dy + \int\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,d\,R}{d\,x^2}\right)dy$
$-\iint\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d^3\,R}{d\,x^3}\right)dx\,dy$
deinde octauum membrum
$\int R'\left(\frac{d^3\,z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right)dy - \int\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{d\,x\,dt}\right)\left(\frac{d\,R'}{d\,x}\right)dy + \int\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,d\,R'}{d\,x\,d\,y}\right)dy$
$-\iint\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d^3\,R'}{d\,x^2\,d\,y}\right)dx\,dy$
tum nonum membrum fiet
$\int R''\left(\frac{d^3\,z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right)dx - \int\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{dy\,dt}\right)\left(\frac{d\,R''}{d\,y}\right)dx + \int\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,d\,R''}{dx\,dy}\right)dx$
$-\iint\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d^3\,R''}{d\,x\,d\,y^2}\right)dx\,dy$
et decimum
$\int R'''\left(\frac{d^3\,z}{d\,y^2\,d\,t}\right)dx - \int\left(\frac{d\,d\,z}{dy\,dt}\right)\left(\frac{d\,R'''}{dy}\right)dx + \int\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d\,d\,R'''}{d\,y^2}\right)dx$
$-\iint\left(\frac{d\,z}{d\,t}\right)\left(\frac{d^3\,R'''}{d\,y^3}\right)dx\,dy.$
